svg.title: How a message leaves
svg.desc: Hermes drafts, the safety rules are checked, then Hermes's own approval prompt shows you the person, the app and the exact words. Only a yes sends it, once.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: HOW A MESSAGE LEAVES · BLUE IS HERMES, GOLD IS YOU
